text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at a gain felt satisfying, but a realized gain alone does not show whether the portfolio is doing well; judge the whole account and each decision by its merits.","I should not hold a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake, or sell a winner just to lock in a gain; my average cost is not a reason to expect future prices to reverse.","Because past price moves do not predict future moves and I check only occasionally, I should set a clear allocation and review plan rather than let inertia or short-term account changes drive my trades."]}
